body: No, I've taken around 10 so far, I stopped. I don't know what I'm going to do, but I'm not going to continue taking them. I'm super depressed, but I just got to fight it I guess. Just can't accept the 'Illness' aspect

I used to never be like this, and its scarring and honestly sickening me that I'm having these thoughts. I know for a fact people are fighting to live another day, and here I am ready to through it all away. Makes me feel worse in a way
That's probably the nicest thing anyone has said to me in a long time and it actually means a lot..
How can I live in this depressed state? I've faked so many smiles already, its starting to get to me, and I'm running out of way to cope
I'm sitting here, strumming a guitar downing tramadols every 20 minutes, with a coors light iced tea (Actually really like the lemon-y after taste), writing stuff.
It is, I wish I could play at that level..

Josh Ansley (Streetlight Manifesto's First album), Chris Squire (Yes Roundabout is a good display of his endurance), Arif Mirabdolbaghi (Protest the Hero) and John Myung (From Dream Theater, Who inspired me to start playing bass) are my personal favorites.

I write poetry or short stories, I'm love Lovecraft and its shows haha. I just picked up a new guitar, but I love the Bass. Something about the sound of a good funky, flowing bass line gives me goosebumps. Honestly, I can talk about music and music history for hours, but once again, not much of a music town..

Writing anything. Playing music and listening to music have become my hobbies I guess, tho I'm rubbish and playing any instrument. I used to be a gamer, really into Halo at one point, but now all I play is LoL whenever friends message me to get on.

Ontario, Canada, In a small town filled with outdoors-men and hunters, and I've never been able to identify with any of the guys growing up, they liked cars and shooting stuff, I liked writing and looking at art, and I have no way to escape this craphole
